queries_run: NXP Semiconductors China export control OR trade restriction 2026

findings.claim: NXP FY2025 10-K 風險因子：美國商務部 2025-04 啟動半導體 Section 232 調查，結果未明但預期帶來額外關稅與貿易限制，可能不利其業務；關稅也可能推高原料與設備成本。
findings.excerpt: in April 2025, the Department of Commerce launched an investigation into the national security impacts of imported semiconductors and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. While the results of this investigation remain unknown, it is expected to result in additional tariffs and trade restrictions that may adversely impact our business.

findings.claim: NXP 10-K 載明 2020 年因美國政府規定停止對華為出貨（待出口許可），且出口法規趨嚴，客戶或供應商受制裁可能影響需求。
findings.excerpt: For example, in 2020, due to regulations imposed by the U.S. government, we ceased shipments of our products to Huawei pending approval of export licenses.

reg_tariff_export.note: 2026-01-14 公告之 Section 232 半導體關稅（25%）搜尋摘要稱範圍窄、限先進運算晶片且豁免工業／消費電子等用途，摘要未提及 NXP 個別影響；Nexperia 出口限制為另一家公司，非 NXP。未下載 2026 年 10-Q 內文。

clues.claim: Section 232 對特定先進半導體課徵 25% 關稅，自 2026-01-15 生效，豁免工業、消費電子等用途，並有第二階段更廣關稅的可能
